title: review: Fix: acceptance-test gate flags named tests that unittest discover would not collect; write-spec skill requires the tests/<file>::<name> form</title>
spec:
Goal T-0503 hotfix for a gate gap found 2026-09-21. Base goal/T-0503. Work only in your worktree, commit only on your own branch with the task id in the message, run the full .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh before reporting; report sha and failures only.
Facts: orchestrator/acceptance.py named_tests parses only `tests/<file>.py::<name>` (and same-criterion `::<short>`) references; missing_tests(worktree, acceptance) only checks that `def <name>(` exists in the file; daemon.gate (daemon.py:919) holds a task when missing_tests is non-empty. .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh runs pytest only when importable, else `python -m unittest discover -q tests`; pytest is not a project dependency, so a module-level `def test_x():` outside a unittest.TestCase is present in the file but never collected (task T-0506 shipped eight such tests and its gate passed with the base test count). .claude/skills/write-spec/SKILL.md tells the Planner to name tests but not in which form.
1. acceptance.missing_tests: additionally report a named test as missing (with a distinguishable reason, e.g. a third tuple element "not_collected") when the def is found at module level (zero indentation) and the worktree's runner is unittest (pytest not importable in the project venv; detect the same way tests-green.sh does, or via a `runner` parameter defaulting to that detection). Keep the return shape backward compatible for callers that unpack (path, name): return objects that still compare/unpack as before or update the single caller's formatting in resume_hint only if strictly needed (prefer not touching daemon.py).
2. .claude/skills/write-spec/SKILL.md: add one line: acceptance criteria name tests as `tests/test_<module>.py::test_name` (the gate parses only this form; bare names are not verified) and tests are unittest.TestCase methods unless pytest is a project dependency.
3. Tests tests/test_acceptance.py: test_missing_tests_flags_module_level_pytest_style_function_under_unittest, test_missing_tests_accepts_testcase_method, test_named_tests_ignores_bare_names. Existing tests stay green.
acceptance: tests/test_acceptance.py::test_missing_tests_flags_module_level_pytest_style_function_under_unittest passes: a module-level def test_x in a worktree without pytest is reported missing with a not_collected reason
tests/test_acceptance.py::test_missing_tests_accepts_testcase_method and tests/test_acceptance.py::test_named_tests_ignores_bare_names pass; existing acceptance tests stay green
.claude/skills/write-spec/SKILL.md states the tests/test_<module>.py::test_name form and the unittest.TestCase requirement

comments.issue: resume_hint failure messages hardcode '(missing: test not defined)' for every entry, including new NotCollectedTest results where the def does exist but unittest won't collect it. The distinguishing .reason='not_collected' attribute is never read here and won't survive JSON serialization of resume_hint anyway, so the 'distinguishable reason' the spec asked for isn't actually surfaced to whoever debugs the hold. Not required by the stated acceptance criteria and the spec said prefer not touching daemon.py, so not blocking, but worth a follow-up.
